/*selectSellerMpIvDeliveryDelayBuyerChoicePopList*/ SELECT BUYER , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , SUM(DELAY_CNT) AS DELAY_CNT FROM ( SELECT C.BUYER , C.PO_NO , C.PO_SEQ , C.DS_DATE , COUNT(*) AS DELAY_CNT FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPORS C WHERE A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER= B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND B.ITEM_QTY != B.GR_QTY AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ= C.PO_SEQ AND C.STATUS != 'D' AND C.DS_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-31,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1,'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY C.BUYER , C.PO_NO , C.PO_SEQ , C.DS_DATE
HAVING SUM(C.CD_QTY) != NVL((SELECT SUM(DELIVERY_QTY) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = C.BUYER AND PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ= C.PO_SEQ AND DS_DATE=C.DS_DATE AND STATUS != 'D'),0) ) GROUP BY BUYER ORDER BY 2
